latest.title: Triggering Lambda Durable Functions from SQS
latest.description: Lambda durable functions support executions up to 1 year, but SQS event source mappings cap that to 15 minutes. Learn why, and two ways to work around it.

latest.title: Processamento de Fluxo Contínuo com Estado: Detecção de Fraudes em Tempo Real usando Amazon MSK e Apache Flink
latest.description: Uma análise arquitetônica avançada sobre a construção de pipelines de dados com estado (stateful stream processing) operando em latência de milissegundos. O artigo tensiona as limitações sistêmicas do processamento em lote e detalha a orquestração do Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (MSK) acoplado ao Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink.

latest.title: AWS Security Cards: A Free Reference for 75 AWS Services

latest.title: Meet LocalEmu, the free successor to LocalStack

latest.title: AWS Kiro and OutcomeOps: Better Together for Enterprise Spec-Driven Development
latest.description: Kiro is the spec-driven IDE developers want. OutcomeOps is the organizational intelligence layer they need at enterprise scale. This post walks through how to wire OutcomeOps to Kiro as an MCP server running inside your AWS account, what happens at generation time when ADRs and ISO 27001 controls get cited inline, and why the integration matters for regulated industries.

latest.title: Mastering Chatbots
latest.description:
Have you ever tried to create something with AI and ended up frustrated because the chatbot just wasn't giving you useful answers?

You're definitely not alone. A lot of people think AI is the problem, when in reality it's often the way we communicate our ideas.

In this session, we'll learn how to write better prompts, explain our ideas more clearly, and get much better results from AI tools. Whether you're using ChatGPT to study, work, or build projects, a few simple techniques can make a huge difference.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
